claims: The McDonald's HUNTR/X (Huntrix) Meal was launched on March 31, 2026.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X (Huntrix) Meal was launched as part of the "KPop Demon Hunters" collaboration.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X (Huntrix) Meal features 10-piece Chicken McNuggets.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X (Huntrix) Meal features Ramyeon McShaker Fries.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X (Huntrix) Meal features two special sauces (Hunter Sauce and Demon Sauce).
The McDonald's HUNTR/X (Huntrix) Meal is a lunch/dinner meal.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X (Huntrix) Meal includes a medium drink.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X (Huntrix) Meal includes collectible photo cards.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X (Huntrix) Meal includes a Derpy access card.
